From Marilyn Manson · Price: only on a creature that lost a wager or owes you.

Theme Fate

  • 1: 1 action: demand payment: a creature that owes you (it lost a Soul Wager, took your money, or agreed to a debt) hands over an item of your choice, or takes @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level-1)/4))d6[force]] damage with no save.
  • 5: Surge: take a debt from a creature that lost a bet: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 1}.
  • 9: Take an organ: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 2}.
  • 13: Two creatures.
  • 17: Take a debtor's soul: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{unconscious} for 1 minute (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates, incapacitation).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
